messages:
maria: FYI i've opened a docs PR to expand the private-installer guide for dual-stack (ipv4+ipv6) + proxy-chaining with HSM/KMS. need quick review before we merge — customers saw PKCS11 init failures when proxies returned ipv6 addresses. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217 :eyes:

sam: linking in. can you summarize the user-facing change? want to check we don't break existing snippets.

maria: short summary: 1) add an explicit ‘networking behavior’ section when ipv6 is enabled, 2) include a connection-checker sample output for macOS + linux, 3) add a proxy-chaining example that preserves SNI for HSM (important for some HSM providers). also fixed the port-table to call out ephemeral ranges.

jin: i can add the macos sample. for the PKCS11 init error do you have the small log snippet? helps for the troubleshooting section.

maria: pasted the minimal log we saw: ```
2026-03-10T15:12:03Z error hsm: pkcs11_init failed: CKR_DEVICE_ERROR
2026-03-10T15:12:03Z warn  installer: attempted connection to 2001:db8::1:4141 via proxy -> handshake timeout
```

sam: ok that points to proxy handshake + ipv6 routing. we should recommend `sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=0` as a check, but warn folks about cluster-wide changes. also add a `curl --resolve` snippet for reproducing with SNI:```
curl -v --resolve hsm.example.com:443:2001:db8::1 \
  --proxy http://proxy.internal:3128 https://hsm.example.com/status
```

tyler: note re: windows users — powershell curl (Invoke-WebRequest) doesn't handle `--resolve`. maybe include a hosts file note and a tiny netshell command:```
# add temp hosts entry as admin
notepad C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts
# then test with Invoke-WebRequest https://hsm.example.com/status
```

maria: good call — i'll add a short paragraph for Windows and a warning about editing hosts.

doc-bot: lint-check: failed — broken link detected at docs/priv-installer/networking.md: reference to internal kb://hsm-providers/handbook not found.

jin: i'll replace the kb link with the public provider guide and add a redirect note. who can run the CI fix?

sam: i'll pick it up after lunch, re-run linkcheck and the spellcheck job. if green i'll merge and tag `docs:private-installer` and add a release note to changelog. :shipit: 

maria: thanks! leaving a quick TODO in the PR for the linux connection-checker output that jin is adding. tag me for final pass — i'll validate the SNI example with our staging HSM.

tyler: small nit — update the port matrix callout to mention ephemeral ports used by the proxy chain (32768-60999) and link to our port-matrix page. i'll open a follow-up PR if you want. :+1:

maria: perfect. assigning reviewers: @sam @jin. aiming to merge today.

sam: ack, will comment on PR with the two CI issues and ETA ~3h.

maria: thanks all. if anyone runs into a customer case while i'm offline, add steps to the troubleshooting checklist in the PR so we don't forget. :pray:
